characters.identityProse: Violet Evergarden from Violet Evergarden, an ethereal and pristine former soldier turned Auto Memories Doll, with mid-back braided golden-blonde hair tied with red ribbons, luminous azure-blue eyes, articulated silver prosthetic mechanical hands, and a doll-like porcelain face brimming with tender emotion

outfits.name: 自动手记人偶宝蓝骑士礼服
